form.name: bookPath
form.label: Where is your book library? (leave empty to not mount anything)

form.name: downloadPath
form.label: Where does your download client put finished downloads? (leave empty to not mount anything)

form.name: user
form.label: User and group to run Bindery as, as numeric UID:GID

Bindery runs on a distroless image that cannot change user itself. A new volume or folder is owned by root, so the default is 0:0. To run as another user, such as 1000:1000, give that user write access to the config volume and your folders first.

form.name: adminOnly
form.label: Do you want to make this service admin only?

post-install.label: Open Bindery, create the first user, then add your indexers and download client under Settings. Bindery reads finished downloads from /downloads, so mount the same folder in your download client or set a path remap on the client in Settings, Download clients.
